mage-arena-i.player: Hello my friend, Kolodion sent me down.

mage-arena-i.npc: Sssshhh... the gods are talking. I can hear their whispers.
Can you hear them adventurer, they're calling you.
Go chant at the statue of the god you most wish to represent in this world, you will be rewarded.
Once you are done, come back to me. I shall supply you with a mage staff ready for battle.

mage-arena-i-after-choosing-a-cape.npc: Hello adventurer, have you made your choice?

mage-arena-i-after-choosing-a-cape.text: If the player doesn't have the cape with them:

steps.npc: Good, good, I hope you have chosen well. Have you been rewarded with a cape from your chosen god?

steps.player: I'm afraid I don't have it with me.

steps.npc: Once you have your cape come back to me, and I shall supply you with a mage staff ready for battle.

mage-arena-i-after-choosing-a-cape.text: If the player has the cape with them:

steps.npc: Good, good, I hope you have chosen well. I will now present you with a magic staff. This, along with the cape awarded to you by your chosen god, are all the weapons and armour you will need here.

steps.text: The guardian hands you an ornate magic staff.
The guardian hands you an ornate magic staff.

post-miniquest.npc: Hello adventurer, are you looking for another staff?

options.text: What do you have to offer?

steps.npc: Well let me know if you need one.

options.text: Tell me what you know about the charge spell.

steps.player: Tell me what you know about the charge spell.

steps.npc: We believe the spells are gifts from the gods. The charge spell draws even more power from the cosmos.
While wearing a matching cape and staff it will add 50% more damage to that already caused by battle mage spells for several minutes.
